title: 20V MAX* Cordless 5-spot Green Line Laser (Tool Only)
text: 20V MAX* Cordless 5-spot Green Line Laser (Tool Only)Skip to main contentDCLE34520GB20V MAX* Cordless 5-spot Green Line Laser (Tool Only)ReviewsProduct detailsTackle professional-level projects with the 20V MAX* cordless 5-spot green line laser that easily integrates with the tools you already have. Now offered as a part of the 20V MAX* cordless platform, this laser delivers reliable performance without the inconvenience of power cords, featuring a sturdy magnetic mount, flexible rotating head, fine adjust knob for control, and locking pendulum for enhanced usability. Get more done with this laser which keeps a charge for up to 17 hours when equipped with the 20V MAX* 2ah battery (sold separately). This kit includes the 5-spot green line laser, ceiling/wall bracket, and laser target in a DEWALT® TSTAK® case. Battery & charger sold separatelyRange - 280 ft. Visibile and 330 ft.
